description: Machine-readable index of the dashboard prototyping resources. Read by the dataesr-mcp /tableaux server from GitHub; keep it in sync with README.md.

guidance.title: Prototyping conventions, data sources, common vs dedicated code, manifest
Skill: plan and orchestrate a whole dashboard prototype (delegates to new-board, new-chart, dsfr)
Skill: scaffold a board (client folder, server router, fixtures, registration rules)

templates.title: Client board skeleton
templates.description: Routes, layouts, pages, i18n, styles and sitemap config. A reference to adapt, not a generator.
templates.notes: global-layout.tsx contains a theme button and a language selector built with DSFR JS-only attributes (data-fr-opened, aria-controls, fr-collapse); DSFR JS is not loaded, so do not copy those sections. The chart pages are not part of the skeleton; see the chart examples.

templates.title: Server router stub
templates.description: Minimal board router, one route and an .http request file. The fixtures layer is the board-server-fixtures template.

templates.title: Server fixtures layer
templates.description: readFixture() helper isolating data access in one place, one example fixture with a provenance field, a fixture-backed route using the { data, provenance } envelope, and an .http test.

templates.title: Board manifest JSON Schema
templates.description: Schema of board.manifest.json; the README documents the fields and an example.
